note: #steps above the 50,000,000 ceiling is a CodegenError. The interpreter never reads the pragma -- interpret() takes its budget as a parameter -- so it runs the program without noticing. Milder than 006 because nothing unbounded happens, and recorded anyway because the accept/reject boundary of the language is `compile_source`, not `parse_program`, and the two differ. `obsign-replayc check` refuses a program interpret_source will happily run.
